name: lookup_node
author: instructors
description: Finds node ids from a name. Use it whenever a question names a node (a person, an airport, a city, a course), because other tools need node ids, not names. Tolerates small spelling mistakes. Returns the best-matching nodes with a match score from 0 to 1; an empty list means nothing matched.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to search.

name.description: The name to look for, e.g. 'Chennai' or 'Valjean'.

top_k.description: Maximum number of matches to return.
